source.title: Dragonflight original prospecting/milling completed-cast research — source-search checkpoint

notes: Searches included named inputs and original worksheets across Reddit, GitHub, Warcraft Wiki, WoWhead, wow-professions and Blizzard forums. No NEW independent rank-specific original 0-N material-by-cast table or refund-aware completed operation ledger was confirmed. Existing cited high-priority studies deliberately not duplicated. Followed open T0041 prospect/mill search before standing Dragonflight gear DE fallback.
lookingFor: T0020, T0018, T0015, T0041 and T0046: novel Dragonflight Draconium/Serevite/Khaz'gorite/Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage mill completed-cast per-output histograms
whereLooked: reddit.com/r/woweconomy: named original Draconium Ore and Serevite Ore cast-by-cast ore/refund datasets; search surfaced already imported 109bytz/zzyjzu/10i63zb, no new 0-N log
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: named Khaz'gorite Ore prospecting results; original 2023 ore posts lacked a new per-output hit histogram
reddit.com/r/woweconomy: Bubble Poppy milling pigment quantities spreadsheet (named search); no unindexed original completed-mill ledger
github.com: named Serevite Ore / Draconium Ore prospecting csv and castsWithDrop searches; no public new player export
warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Prismatic_Ore and /wiki/Serevite_Ore: identity/patch notes only; no raw material per-cast 0-N ledger
wowhead.com/spell=374627/dragon-isles-prospecting: known Bugy original table, no new independent zero-inclusive histogram
wowhead.com/item=194545/prismatic-ore: known original superbondez data, already indexed
